posts.author: Axel_FireForged
posts.body:
I wanted to know if I can program in a way to make text to create a sound when drawn into the screen. Wether it's a custom script or a simple edit to a script already present in base VXA.
Then if possible control what sounds play during a character's dialogue.
Had the thought while watching Underevent 2024 actually lol.

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
I don't know, can you do this? Is that what your asking?
I mean your after is a TTS, text to speech script.
As for how it sounds would be the more difficult part, pitch, volume, pace etc.
Your probs better off getting a AI voice app and with one that allows you to edit how each line is spoke.
If your requesting a script then that's going to be a hefty script to write.

It is not "voice acting" per se. When a character in Deltarune speaks, a sound effect is reproduced for each letter the text has. Not a dialog spoken line. Think of Animal Crossing animalese's?
